suite_info.name: Testy Zacharskiego – JSON and code format
suite_info.author: Rafał Zacharski (AI Bóbr)
suite_info.description: Does quantization break structured output? Strict and lenient JSON, value checks, Python syntax. Generated code is parsed, never executed.

tests.title: Extract hardware specs
tests.prompt: Extract the hardware specs into a JSON object with keys "cpu" (string), "ram_gb" (number) and "vram_gb" (number): "System has a Ryzen 7 5700X, 32 GB of RAM and an RTX 2060 SUPER with 8 GB of VRAM." Return ONLY the JSON.

tests.title: Array of numbers
tests.prompt: Return a JSON array with the first five prime numbers. Return ONLY the JSON.

tests.title: Typed fields and a nested list
tests.prompt: Convert to a JSON object with keys "name" (string), "age" (number) and "skills" (array of strings): "Anna is 34 and knows Python and SQL." Return ONLY the JSON.

tests.title: Quotes and backslash escaping
tests.prompt: Return a JSON object with a single key "quote" whose value is exactly this text: She said "hi" and left \ fast. Return ONLY the JSON.

tests.title: Python function – palindrome
tests.prompt: Write a Python function is_palindrome(s) that returns True if the string s reads the same backwards, ignoring case and spaces. Return only the code.

tests.title: Python function – Fibonacci list
tests.prompt: Write a Python function fibonacci(n) that returns a list with the first n Fibonacci numbers, starting with 0 and 1. Return only the code.

tests.title: Python class with a method
tests.prompt: Write a Python class Stack with methods push(item), pop() and is_empty(). Return only the code.
